finding_summary: No P0, P1, P2, or P3 findings.

identity.contract_gate_note: The reduced repository framework uses scripts/check_common_contracts.py plus exact frozen infrastructure index, contract, and source-manifest SHA checks; scripts/design_contracts.py is absent.

configuration.owner_semantics: single exclusive module-port role per bank
configuration.parameter_guard: BANK_NUM >= 1 and PORT_ROLE_WIDTH >= 3, checked in simulation; default configuration is legal

static_contract_audit.acquire_atomicity: All asserted acquire entries are scanned before commit. Any currently busy requested bank suppresses the complete acquire set.
static_contract_audit.release_atomicity: All asserted release entries are scanned before commit. Any free bank or owner mismatch suppresses the complete release set.
static_contract_audit.overlap: Any bank asserted in both acquire and release suppresses both complete request sets and records overlap error.
static_contract_audit.disjoint_same_cycle: A fully valid release set and a disjoint conflict-free acquire set commit together on one edge.
static_contract_audit.owner_storage: Each busy bank stores exactly one PORT_ROLE_WIDTH owner. The same role may own several different banks.
static_contract_audit.state_protection: An active bank cannot be overwritten by acquire; a nonmatching release cannot clear it.
static_contract_audit.sticky_fault: First fault is retained until reset. Priority for simultaneous first faults is overlap, acquire conflict, release free, then release owner mismatch.
static_contract_audit.reset: Synchronous active-low reset clears every busy bit, every owner, and all fault state and wins over asserted requests.
static_contract_audit.request_replay_semantics: Each asserted valid bit is a new request on each active clock edge. Integration must pulse requests or otherwise prevent unintended replay.

coverage: bank zero acquire and matching release
busy operand rejects entire acquire set
owner mismatch rejects entire release set
atomic bank0 plus bank4 acquire by the same role
three-bank GEMM acquire on banks 0, 7, and 15 with roles 3, 4, and 5
one mismatching owner rolls back the complete three-bank release
later overlap cannot overwrite the sticky first mismatch fault
one busy bank rolls back the complete three-bank acquire
one free release target rolls back an otherwise matching release
same-bank overlap blocks release plus every member of the acquire set
matching release and disjoint acquire commit on the same edge
same role retains ownership of multiple banks
reset wins over simultaneous asserted acquire and release and clears all 16 banks

verilator.warnings: Six LITENDIAN warnings arise only from the contract-required ascending [0:BANK_NUM-1] request and state arrays.

vivado_ooc.source_closure: one synthesizable source, bank_ownership_table.sv; no testbench, generated IP, memory, or blackbox
vivado_ooc.timing_exceptions: Hold-only false paths cover unplaced external input/output ports. Internal register-to-register hold remains timed; the worst hold path is ownership_error_reg/Q to ownership_error_reg/D.
vivado_ooc.warnings: The empty blackbox query and incomplete connectivity-based OOC DRC/methodology warnings are consistent with a standalone unplaced module. No routed or board claim is made.

scope_and_limitations.validated: Standalone bank ownership metadata control at default 16-bank configuration, including all-or-none acquire/release, disjoint same-cycle operations, role storage, fault stickiness, reset, lint, and 200 MHz post-synthesis OOC timing.
residual_risks: Integration must guarantee one request per intended edge; holding acquire_valid after a successful acquire intentionally replays the request and produces an acquire conflict.
The dispatcher-to-ownership vectors, release-priority interaction with other integrated control, and ownership-to-router wiring require integration-level verification.
OOC external-port hold paths are intentionally excluded because ports are unplaced; fresh in-context placed/routed timing remains required.
